    actor_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rentals,
    ROUND((COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental)) * 1.0 / 5, 2) AS percentage

    actor_id
ORDER BY 
    percentage DESC
LIMIT 5;
